ruleDefinitions.name: Local System Accounts Discovery - MacOs
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects enumeration of local systeam accounts on MacOS

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\/dscl$") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*list.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/users.*"))) OR (process_path = RGX("\\/dscacheutil$") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-q.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*user.*"))) OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\'x\\:0\\:\\.*") OR (process_path = RGX("\\/cat$") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/etc\\/passwd.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/etc\\/sudoers.*"))) OR process_path = RGX("\\/id$") OR (process_path = RGX("\\/lsof$") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-u.*")))
